description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Xin Zhao''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to the target enemy's location, dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] all targets hit by 30% for 0.5 seconds. ''Audacious Charge's'' range is increased against ''[[File:Xin Zhao Challenged.png|20xpx|link=Xin Zhao#Challenged|An icon for Xin Zhao's ability Challenged]] [[Xin Zhao#Challenged|Challenged]]'' targets.
description.text: Active: Xin Zhao dashes to the target enemy's location, dealing magic damage to them and nearby enemies and slowing all targets hit by 30% for 0.5 seconds. Audacious Charge's range is increased against Challenged targets.

description2.raw: '''Xin Zhao''' then gains [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] '''bonus''' attack speed for 5 seconds.
description2.text: Xin Zhao then gains  bonus attack speed for 5 seconds.

description3.raw: ''[[File:Xin Zhao Three Talon Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Xin Zhao#Three Talon Strike|An icon for Xin Zhao's ability Three Talon Strike]] [[Xin Zhao#Three Talon Strike|Three Talon Strike]] and [[File:Xin Zhao Crescent Guard.png|20xpx|border|link=Xin Zhao#Crescent Guard|An icon for Xin Zhao's ability Crescent Guard]] [[Xin Zhao#Crescent Guard|Crescent Guard]] can be cast during the dash.''
description3.text: Three Talon Strike and Crescent Guard can be cast during the dash.

leveling.raw:
'''Magic Damage:'''
50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 (+ 120% AP)

leveling2.raw:

38 / 46 / 54 / 62 / 70% (+ 10% per 100 AP) (+ 1% per 5% '''bonus''' attack speed from non-buff sources)
leveling2.text: Bonus Attack Speed:38 / 46 / 54 / 62 / 70% (+ 10% per 100 AP) (+ 1% per 5% bonus attack speed from non-buff sources)

notes.raw: * The primary target cannot dodge ''Audacious Charge's'' effects. ** The target will always emit the area of effect from their position. * ''Audacious Charge'' has a [[File:Targeting forgiveness.svg|20px|link=Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|An icon representing the keyword Targeting forgiveness]] [[:Targeting#Targeting_Forgiveness|forgiveness radius]] of 200 units.
notes.text:
The primary target cannot dodge Audacious Charge's effects.
* The target will always emit the area of effect from their position.
Audacious Charge has a forgiveness radius of 200 units.
